bio.text: Bethany Mann is the Democratic nominee for Missouri's 3rd Congressional District in 2026, facing Republican Rep. Bob Onder in the November general election.
According to her campaign website, she grew up in Foristell, lives in St. Peters, and works as an environmental chemist.
She was also the Democratic candidate in the district in 2022, against Rep. Blaine Luetkemeyer, and in 2024, against Onder.
